scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @myaccounting/api" "npm run dev --workspace @myaccounting/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @myaccounting/api && npm run build --workspace @myaccounting/web
scripts.pwa:test: npm run build --workspace @myaccounting/web && concurrently -k -n preview,tunnel -c green,magenta "npm run preview:mobile --workspace @myaccounting/web" "npx localtunnel --port 4173"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @myaccounting/api && npm run lint --workspace @myaccounting/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @myaccounting/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @myaccounting/web
